texts.preamble: Sudhakar Kalyan Pansare And Anr vs The State Of Maharashtra on 25 September, 2023 Author: N. J. Jamadar Bench: N. J. Jamadar 31-Aba2598-2023.Doc Santosh In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction Anticipatory Bail Application No. 2598 Of 2023 Sudhakar Kalyan Pansare and anr. ...Applicants Versus State of Maharashtraq ...Respondent Mr. Pranav Pokale, for the Applicants. Ms. Pallavi Dabholkar, App for the State/Respondent. Api R. D. Gawade, Local Crime Branch, Pune Rural, present. Coram: N. J. Jamadar, J. Dated: 25th September, 2023 Order:
texts.facts: 2. This application is preferred for pre-arrest bail in connection with CR No.260 of 2023, registered with Rajgad Police Station, Pune Rural, for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 269, 273 and 328 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 ("the Penal Code") and Sections 26(2)(i), 26(2)(a), 27(3) and 59(iii) of The Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. 3. On 24th June, 2023 near Morwadi, Post Kikavi, Taluka Bhor an Eicher make tempo was intercepted. Co-accused were found transporting huge quantity of contraband articles 31-ABA2598-2023.DOC - gutkha pan masala. It transpired that the said vehicle was owned by applicant No.1. The learned Counsel for the applicants submitted that, in fact, the person who was allegedly the owner of the contraband articles was granted pre-arrest bail by the Court of Session. Applicant No.2 has no concern with the incident in question and has been roped in for being the brother of applicant No.1, who is the owner of the vehicle. The applicants are not privy to the offences and, therefore, they be enlarged on bail in the event of their arrest. 5. In opposition to this, the learned APP submitted that the investigation has revealed that forged number plates were used to ply the said vehicle. Applicant No.1 has been arraigned in the past for an identical offence at Banda police station vide CR No.14 of 2021. Therefore, custodial interrogation of the applicants is warranted. The said statement is accepted as undertaking given to this Court. 2. No. 260 of 2023 registered with Rajgad Police Station, Pune Rural for offences under Sections 328, 269, 273, 188 of the Indian Penal Code as well as under Sections 26(2)(i), 26(2)(a), 27(3), 59(iii) of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006. 3. As per the prosecution case, on 24 th June, 2023 near Morwadi, Post Kikavi, Taluka Bhor a tempo was intercepted. Co- accused were found transporting huge quantity of contraband articles - gutkha pan masala. During the investigation it was found that the said vehicle of the ownership of the Applicant No. 1 and the Applicant No. 2. 4. Perusal of the record shows that the co-accused who was allegedly the owner of the contraband articles was granted pre- arrest bail by the Learned Sessions Court. The record further shows that a Learned Single Judge by order dated 25 th September 2023 has granted pre-arrest bail to the Applicants and the said order is continued till date.
texts.arguments: Mr. Pokale, learned Counsel appearing for the Applicants tenders unconditional apology for his absence on 19 th September 2025 and he states that voluntarily he will pay Rs.5,000/- as donation to the Bar Council of Maharashtra and Goa. The learned Counsel states that the said donation will be paid within a period of one week from today. Learned Counsel appearing for the Applicants states that the issue regarding applicability of Section 328 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 to such offences is pending in the Hon'ble Supreme Court. 6. Accordingly case is made out for granting Anticipatory Bail. However, learned APP submits that Applicant No. 1 has one antecedent and the same has not been disclosed in the Anticipatory Bail Application. 7. Mr. Pokale, learned Counsel appearing for the Applicants fairly submits that the said antecedent has not been mentioned in the Anticipatory Bail Application. He states that fresh Anticipatory Bail Application will be filed on behalf of Applicant No. 1 by giving particulars of the antecedents and therefore, seeks withdrawal of the Anticipatory Bail Application as far as Applicant No. 1 is concerned.
